No, they are entirely different scenarios.

---

**Frosthaven Scenario 61 — "Life and Death"**
- **Source:** Scenario Book (pp. 62–81)
- **Complexity:** 2
- **Monsters:** Deep Terror, Harrower Infester
- **Objective:** Escort ally Moonshard — kill all enemies; if Moonshard dies, the scenario is lost
- **Special:** Characters add two cards to their attack modifier decks and gain a bonus; Moonshard acts on initiative 50 each round with *(L+(2×C))×2* hit points
- **Unlocks:** Read section 67.1 at scenario end

---

**Gloomhaven (2e) Scenario 61 — "Dangerous Grove"**
- **Flow:** Personal quests branch
- **Monsters:** Cave Bear, Forest Imp, Hound
- **Unlocks:** Scenario 62
- **Objectives:** None listed

---

Beyond sharing the number 61, the two scenarios have different names, different monsters, different objectives, and exist in entirely separate narrative contexts.

Here are both sections, drawn from verified tool results.

---

## Frosthaven — Section 67.1 ("Life and Death")

This section is the conclusion of **Scenario 61: Life and Death**.

> Your ears fill with the sound of your own breathing: heavy, stinging, rib-pulling breaths…

After escaping the cave, your party meets **Moonshard** and her companion **Terra**, an elderly Orchid who reveals she has foreseen this moment for two hundred years. She introduces the **Shattersong** — a unique lineage of quartz Savvas attuned to the thoughts and intentions of the **Harbinger**. Terra explains the Harbinger sleeps deep in the earth, corrupting the seals that bind it through its dreams, and that your party plays a crucial role in stopping its escape.

**Rewards:**
- Unlock class box.

**Section Links:**
- Add **section 140.3** to the calendar in one week.

*(Source: Frosthaven Section Book 62–81, section 67.1)*

---

## Gloomhaven (2nd Edition) — Section 67.1 ("The Last Stand")

This section is part of **Scenario 55: The Last Stand**. It sets up **Room 6** with the following monsters:

| Monster | Notes |
|---|---|
| Black Imp | Normal (1–2p); Elite (3–4p, with one Normal at 4p) |
| Chaos Demon | Normal (1–3p); Elite (4p) |
| Deep Terror | Normal (2–3p); Elite (3–4p) |
| Harrower Infester | Normal (3p); Elite (4p) |

*(Source: Gloomhaven (2nd Edition) Section Book, section 67.1)*

---

## Are They the Same Section?

**No, they are entirely different.** Section numbers are local to each game's section book. Frosthaven's 67.1 is a narrative conclusion with story rewards tied to Scenario 61, while Gloomhaven (2nd Edition)'s 67.1 is a combat room setup tied to Scenario 55. They share only a number.

Here are the two records, exactly as retrieved:

---

**Gloomhaven (2nd Edition) — Section 67.1: "The Last Stand"**
*Source: gloomhavensecretariat:sections/67-1*

This is a structured room-setup section for parent scenario 55. It lists monster placements (Black Imp, Chaos Demon, Deep Terror, Harrower Infester) scaled by player count. It contains no narrative text — only encounter data.

---

**Frosthaven — Section 67.1: "Life and Death" conclusion**
*Source: Section Book 62-81, page 67*

This is a narrative conclusion section linked to Frosthaven scenario 61. It contains a long story passage introducing characters Terra, Moonshard, Crain, and the Shattersong, plus rewards (unlock class box) and a calendar instruction (add section 140.3 in one week).

---

**Can either section be used as evidence for the other game?**

**No.** The two sections share only a number. They are entirely different records — different games, different parent scenarios, different content types, different characters, different rewards, and different mechanical structures. The section numbering in Frosthaven and Gloomhaven (2nd Edition) is independent; the same number in each book refers to unrelated content. Nothing in either record supports, clarifies, or corroborates anything in the other.
